# Tool logo sources

- Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, and FastAPI artwork comes from [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon), under the [MIT license](https://github.com/devicons/devicon/blob/master/LICENSE).
- The DuckDB mark comes from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/icons/duckdb.svg), distributed under [CC0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).
- Microsoft Power BI and Power Query artwork comes from the [Microsoft Power BI Icons collection](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerBI-Icons), under [CC BY 4.0](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerBI-Icons/blob/main/LICENSE).

The logos are scaled and placed in labeled tiles. The DuckDB tile uses a yellow backdrop for its monochrome mark. SQL and DAX use text labels. Product names and logos identify the tools in use.
